chinese: 今天早上我不得不提醒一些学生遵守校规。
english: This morning I had to tell some students to follow the school rules.

chinese: 在走廊里要走路，不要跑！
english: Walk in the hallway. Don’t run!
You have to wear the uniform.

chinese: 绝对不能穿其他衣服来学校。
english: You mustn’t wear other clothes to school instead.

chinese: 不要乱扔垃圾，务必保持学校整洁。
english: Don’t litter. Make sure to keep the school tidy.

chinese: 而最重要的是，我们必须有礼貌，尊重每一个人。
english: And most importantly, we must be polite and treat everyone with respect.

chinese: 如果我们遵守这些规定，我们就能拥有一个快乐又安全的校园！谢谢。
english: If we follow these rules, we can have a happy and safe school! Thank you.
